ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) and 25% low-intensity pixels (black) localized primarily at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Heavy black pigmentation concentrated along the distal margins and trailing edges. The right lobe contains a distinctive pattern of parallel vertical black bands extending from the trailing edge. A dark circular patch is visible near the central base of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with an estimated aperture of 40 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the lateral tips. The trailing edge displays moderate irregular peaks and valleys, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, with the right lobe showing a more pronounced upward sweep at the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular textures on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least 6-8 distinct, parallel vertical dark lines (rake marks) situated on the upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface; extreme irregular topography on the right tip suggesting tissue erosion or heavy parasitic scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated circular dark focal spot located in the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe.
